cards.ex: That dress is a real eye-catcher; you'll definitely turn heads.
cards.exUz: Bu libos haqiqatan ham ko'zni qamashtiradi; siz albatta diqqat markazida bo'lasiz.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli va diqqatni tortadigan narsa haqida.

cards.ex: Those wide-leg jeans are really on trend right now.
cards.exUz: Bu keng oyoqli jinsilar hozir juda moda bo'lmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi zamonda mashhur bo'lgan uslub yoki tendensiya.

cards.ex: We should dress up for the art gallery opening.
cards.exUz: Biz san'at galereyasining ochilishiga yaxshiroq kiyinishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy kiyimlardan ko'ra rasmiyroq kiyinmoq.

cards.ex: I just threw together this outfit from what I had in my closet.
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki shkafdagi narsalarimdan bu kiyimni tezda tayyorladim.
cards.uzDef: Tez va osonlik bilan bir narsani yaratmoq yoki tayyorlamoq.

cards.ex: A simple black dress is always a classic look.
cards.exUz: Oddiy qora libos har doim klassik ko'rinish bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qachon modadan ketmaydigan uslub.

cards.ex: I don't think I could pull off that bright orange color.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, men bu yorqin apelsin rangini uddalay olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki noodatiy narsani muvaffaqiyatli kiyish yoki qilish.

cards.ex: She always stands out with her unique sense of style.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'zining noyob uslubi bilan ajralib turadi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan farqli bo'lish, diqqatni tortish.

cards.ex: The artist created some truly eye-catching installations.
cards.exUz: Rassom haqiqatan ham diqqatni tortuvchi installyatsiyalarni yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli yoki qiziqarli bo'lib, diqqatni jalb qiluvchi.

cards.ex: She's known for her fashion-forward and daring outfits.
cards.exUz: U o'zining moda ixlosmandi va jasur kiyimlari bilan tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: Modada eng so'nggi tendensiyalarni qabul qiluvchi.

cards.ex: The sculpture in the park is a true piece of art.
cards.exUz: Parkdagi haykal haqiqiy san'at asaridir.
cards.uzDef: Yaratuvchanlik va mahorat bilan yaratilgan narsa.

cards.ex: That scarf will really go with your blue coat.
cards.exUz: Bu sharf sizning ko'k paltoingizga juda mos keladi.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsa boshqa narsa bilan yaxshi ko'rinish yoki mos kelish.

cards.ex: I like to mix and match different patterns to create unique looks.
cards.exUz: Men noyob ko'rinishlar yaratish uchun turli naqshlarni aralashtirishni yoqtiraman.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil kiyim yoki aksessuarlarni birga kiyish, moslashtirish.

cards.ex: Her bold jewelry is definitely a fashion statement.
cards.exUz: Uning qalin taqinchoqlari, albatta, moda ifodasidir.
cards.uzDef: O'z uslubi orqali o'z shaxsiyatini ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: She has a keen eye for detail when it comes to design.
cards.exUz: U dizayn haqida gap ketganda, tafsilotlarga o'tkir nigoh bilan qaraydi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaga e'tibor berishni biladigan yaxshi sezgi.

cards.ex: Some of her jewelry designs are truly wearable art.
cards.exUz: Uning ba'zi zargarlik dizaynlari haqiqatan ham kiyiladigan san'atdir.
cards.uzDef: San'at asari sifatida kiyiladigan kiyim yoki zargarlik buyumlari.

cards.ex: She always looks so put together, even on casual days.
cards.exUz: U har doim shunday tartibli ko'rinadi, hatto oddiy kunlarda ham.
cards.uzDef: Ozoda va yaxshi muvofiqlashtirilgan ko'rinish.

cards.ex: She only buys high-end designer clothes.
cards.exUz: U faqat yuqori sifatli dizaynerlik kiyimlarini sotib oladi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yuqori sifatli va qimmat.

cards.ex: The museum features cutting-edge contemporary art.
cards.exUz: Muzeyda eng zamonaviy san'at asarlari namoyish etilgan.
cards.uzDef: Eng yangi va eng zamonaviy.

cards.ex: Add a touch of red to your outfit for a pop of color.
cards.exUz: Rangi ochish uchun kiyimingizga bir oz qizil qo'shing.
cards.uzDef: Ozgina miqdorda biror narsa qo'shish.

cards.ex: The little black dress is a timeless design.
cards.exUz: Kichik qora libos abadiy dizayndir.
cards.uzDef: Hech qachon modadan ketmaydigan dizayn.

cards.ex: I'm trying to figure out what to wear to the party.
cards.exUz: Men ziyofatga nima kiyishni aniqlashga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunish yoki yechimini topish.

cards.ex: I need to put on my jacket before we go out.
cards.exUz: Chiqishdan oldin jaketimni kiyib olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kiyim kiyish yoki makiyaj qilish.

cards.ex: She likes to show off her new designer handbag.
cards.exUz: U yangi dizaynerlik sumkasini ko'rsatib qo'yishni yoqtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarni hayratga solish uchun biror narsani namoyish etish.

cards.ex: What does this symbol stand for in fashion?
cards.exUz: Bu belgi modada nimani anglatadi?
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning ramzi yoki vakili bo'lish.

cards.ex: The artist used a vibrant color palette in the painting.
cards.exUz: Rassom rasmda yorqin ranglar palitrasidan foydalangan.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda ishlatiladigan ranglarning to'plami.

cards.ex: This vintage dress is one-of-a-kind.
cards.exUz: Bu vintage libos yagona nusxadir.
cards.uzDef: O'xshashi yo'q, noyob narsa.

cards.ex: The dress code for the event is semi-formal.
cards.exUz: Tadbir uchun kiyim kodi yarim rasmiydir.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan joyda kiyilishi kerak bo'lgan kiyim qoidalari.

cards.ex: Check out the designer's new lookbook for inspiration.
cards.exUz: Ilhom olish uchun dizaynerning yangi ko'rinishlar kitobini ko'rib chiqing.
cards.uzDef: Dizaynerning yangi kollektsiyasini namoyish etuvchi fotosuratlar to'plami.

cards.ex: She's always ahead of the curve when it comes to fashion.
cards.exUz: U moda haqida gap ketganda har doim trenddan oldinda bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Moda tendensiyalaridan oldinda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Wearing socks with sandals is a major fashion faux pas.
cards.exUz: Sandal bilan paypoq kiyish katta moda xatosidir.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilinmaydigan moda xatosi.
